name: universal-media-extractor
description: A multi-platform media downloader using Express, FFmpeg, and yt-dlp

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { helpers } = require('ytdlp-nodejs'); helpers.downloadYtDlp().then(p => console.log('[BUILD] yt-dlp binary ready at:', p)).catch(err => console.warn('[BUILD] yt-dlp postinstall warning:', err.message));"
